BATCH_SIZE = 64
LR = 1e-4
NUM_EPOCHS = 50
tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")


def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [
        "sum_even",
        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",
        "all_unique",
    ]


class HF_ClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.dsname = dsname
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
                arr3 = np.repeat(arr[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)
                arr3 = pad_image(arr3, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


class HF_SVHNClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims("svhn")
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"], dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[2] == 3:
                    arr = np.transpose(arr, (2, 0, 1))
                arr28 = pad_image(arr, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr28))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier_FreezeVision(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        for param in self.vision.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False  # Important change: Freeze vision!
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        with torch.no_grad():
            vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)  # Ensure no accidental grads if .train()
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts
    return np.mean(correct)


def train_on_dataset_freezevision(name, dataset, in_c):
    print(f"\n(FreezeVision) Training on {name} ...")
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier_FreezeVision(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, model.parameters()), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        correct = 0
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        ntrain = train_len
        train_acc = correct / ntrain
        train_loss = total_loss / ntrain
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["losses"]["train"].append(train_loss)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["metrics"]["train_logic"].append(
            train_logic
        )
        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        vcorrect = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in val_loader:
                imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
                input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
                attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
                labels = labels.to(device)
                output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
                loss = criterion(output, labels)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
                preds = (output > 0.5).float()
                vcorrect += (preds == labels).sum().item()
                all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        nval = val_len
        val_acc = vcorrect / nval
        val_loss = val_loss / nval
        vpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        vgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        vlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        val_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(vpreds, vgts, vlogicvecs)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["metrics"]["val"].append(val_acc)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["losses"]["val"].append(val_loss)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["metrics"]["val_logic"].append(val_logic)
        experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["epochs"].append(epoch + 1)
        print(
            f"(FV) Epoch {epoch+1}: validation_loss = {val_loss:.4f}  | val_acc = {val_acc:.4f}  | val_logic_acc = {val_logic:.4f}"
        )
        if epoch == NUM_EPOCHS - 1:
            experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["predictions"] = vpreds
            experiment_data["freeze_vision"][name]["ground_truth"] = vgts

import os

import torch

import numpy as np
import random
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from transformers import BertTokenizer, BertModel
from datasets import load_dataset
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

experiment_data = {
    "shuffle_claim_text": {

}

BATCH_SIZE = 64
LR = 1e-4
NUM_EPOCHS = 50
tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")


def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [
        "sum_even",
        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",
        "all_unique",
    ]


class HF_ClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.dsname = dsname
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
                arr3 = np.repeat(arr[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)
                arr3 = pad_image(arr3, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,  # (3,3,28,28)
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


class HF_SVHNClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims("svhn")
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"], dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[2] == 3:
                    arr = np.transpose(arr, (2, 0, 1))
                arr28 = pad_image(arr, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr28))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])  # (B,3,28,28)
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)  # (B,9,28,28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


def shuffle_claims_in_batch(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec):
    idx = torch.randperm(imgs.shape[0])
    input_ids_shuf = input_ids[idx]
    attn_mask_shuf = attn_mask[idx]
    return imgs, input_ids_shuf, attn_mask_shuf, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),  # 32x28x28
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),  # 64x28x28
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),  # 64x14x14
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),  # 128x14x14
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),  # 128x7x7
            nn.Flatten(),  # 128*7*7
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts
    return np.mean(correct)


def train_on_dataset_ablation(name, dataset, in_c):
    print(f"\nAblation: Shuffle Claim-Text, Training on {name} ...")
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        correct = 0
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            # --- Shuffle claim text & attn_mask only ---
            imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec = shuffle_claims_in_batch(
                imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec
            )
            imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        ntrain = train_len
        train_acc = correct / ntrain
        train_loss = total_loss / ntrain
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["metrics"]["train"].append(
            train_acc
        )
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["losses"]["train"].append(
            train_loss
        )
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["metrics"]["train_logic"].append(
            train_logic
        )
        # Validation (Do NOT shuffle)
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        vcorrect = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in val_loader:
                imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
                input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
                attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
                labels = labels.to(device)
                output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
                loss = criterion(output, labels)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
                preds = (output > 0.5).float()
                vcorrect += (preds == labels).sum().item()
                all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        nval = val_len
        val_acc = vcorrect / nval
        val_loss = val_loss / nval
        vpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        vgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        vlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        val_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(vpreds, vgts, vlogicvecs)
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["metrics"]["val"].append(val_acc)
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["losses"]["val"].append(val_loss)
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["metrics"]["val_logic"].append(
            val_logic
        )
        experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["epochs"].append(epoch + 1)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1}: validation_loss = {val_loss:.4f}  | val_acc = {val_acc:.4f}  | val_logic_acc = {val_logic:.4f}"
        )
        if epoch == NUM_EPOCHS - 1:
            experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["predictions"] = vpreds
            experiment_data["shuffle_claim_text"][name]["ground_truth"] = vgts

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [
        "sum_even",
        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",
        "all_unique",
    ]


class HF_ClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.dsname = dsname
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
                arr3 = np.repeat(arr[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)
                arr3 = pad_image(arr3, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,  # (3,3,28,28)
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


class HF_SVHNClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims("svhn")
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"], dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[2] == 3:
                    arr = np.transpose(arr, (2, 0, 1))
                arr28 = pad_image(arr, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr28))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)  # (B,9,28,28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


# Updated model: late fusion only, no feature concatenation
class LateFusionOnlyClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        # Separate MLP heads for vision and text
        self.vision_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 96),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(96, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.text_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 96),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(96, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        vis_pred = self.vision_head(vis_feat).squeeze(1)
        txt_pred = self.text_head(txt_feat).squeeze(1)
        return (vis_pred + txt_pred) / 2  # late (mean) fusion


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts
    return np.mean(correct)


def train_on_dataset(name, dataset, in_c):
    print(f"\nTraining on {name} ...")
    experiment = experiment_data["late_fusion_only_ablation"][name]
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = LateFusionOnlyClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        correct = 0
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        ntrain = train_len
        train_acc = correct / ntrain
        train_loss = total_loss / ntrain
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)
        experiment["losses"]["train"].append(train_loss)
        experiment["metrics"]["train_logic"].append(train_logic)
        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        vcorrect = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in val_loader:
                imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
                input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
                attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)

                output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
                loss = criterion(output, labels)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
                preds = (output > 0.5).float()
                vcorrect += (preds == labels).sum().item()
                all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        nval = val_len
        val_acc = vcorrect / nval
        val_loss = val_loss / nval
        vpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        vgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        vlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        val_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(vpreds, vgts, vlogicvecs)
        experiment["metrics"]["val"].append(val_acc)
        experiment["losses"]["val"].append(val_loss)
        experiment["metrics"]["val_logic"].append(val_logic)
        experiment["epochs"].append(epoch + 1)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1}: validation_loss = {val_loss:.4f}  | val_acc = {val_acc:.4f}  | val_logic_acc = {val_logic:.4f}"
        )

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)

        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0

        res[

        ] = img[

        ]
        return res
    else:

def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):

class HF_ClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer

        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
                arr3 = np.repeat(arr[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)
                arr3 = pad_image(arr3, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))

            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):

def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts
    return np.mean(correct)


def train_on_dataset(ablation_key, name, dataset, in_c):
    print(f"\n[{ablation_key}] Training on {name} ...")
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        correct = 0
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels = (
                imgs.to(device).float(),
                input_ids.to(device),
                attn_mask.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        ntrain = train_len
        train_acc = correct / ntrain
        train_loss = total_loss / ntrain
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["losses"]["train"].append(train_loss)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["metrics"]["train_logic"].append(
            train_logic
        )
        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        vcorrect = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in val_loader:
                imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels = (
                    imgs.to(device).float(),
                    input_ids.to(device),

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)

def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


# CNNVisionEncoder with dropout controlled by argument
class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9, use_dropout=False, dropout_p=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        d = dropout_p if use_dropout else 0.0
        # place dropout after each conv/linear, as ablation point
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),  # 32x28x28
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout2d(d),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),  # 64x28x28
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout2d(d),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),  # 128x14x14
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout2d(d),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(d),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True, use_dropout=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(
            input_channels=in_c, use_dropout=use_dropout, dropout_p=0.3
        )
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts

def train_on_dataset(ablation, name, dataset, in_c, use_dropout):
    print(f"\n[{ablation}] Training on {name} ...")
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True, use_dropout=use_dropout).to(
        device
    )
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        correct = 0
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())

        ntrain = train_len

        train_loss = total_loss / ntrain
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment_data[ablation][name]["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)

        # Validation

        val_loss = 0.0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [
        "sum_even",
        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",
        "all_unique",
    ]


class HF_ClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.dsname = dsname
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
                arr3 = np.repeat(arr[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)
                arr3 = pad_image(arr3, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            # logicvec still returned, but not used
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


class HF_SVHNClaimDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims("svhn")
        self.samples = self._generate()

    def _generate(self):
        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):
            indices = random.sample(range(N), 3)
            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:
                arr = np.array(self.data[i]["image"], dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[2] == 3:
                    arr = np.transpose(arr, (2, 0, 1))
                arr28 = pad_image(arr, target_size=(28, 28))
                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr28))
                labels.append(self.data[i]["label"])
            text, truth, logicvec = generate_claim(labels, self.available_claims)
            samples.append(
                (torch.stack(imgs, 0), text, truth, np.array(labels), logicvec)
            )
        return samples

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        imgs, text, label, digits, logicvec = self.samples[idx]
        enc = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            return_tensors="pt",
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=32,
        )
        input_ids = enc["input_ids"].squeeze(0)
        attn_mask = enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(0)
        return (
            imgs,
            input_ids,
            attn_mask,
            torch.tensor(label, dtype=torch.float32),
            torch.tensor(logicvec, dtype=torch.int64),
        )


def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)  # (B,9,28,28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def train_on_dataset_no_logic(name, dataset, in_c):
    ablation_key = "no_logic_supervision"
    print(f"\n[NO LOGIC SUPERVISION] Training on {name} ...")
    train_len = int(0.85 * len(dataset))
    val_len = len(dataset) - train_len
    train_set, val_set = random_split(
        dataset, [train_len, val_len], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
    )
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_set,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()
    expdat = experiment_data[ablation_key][name]

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        correct = 0
        all_preds, all_labels = [], []
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, _logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(device).float()
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            attn_mask = attn_mask.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
        ntrain = train_len
        train_acc = correct / ntrain

        expdat["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)

        with torch.no_grad():

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [

        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",

    ]

def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])
    imgs = imgs.view(len(batch), -1, 28, 28)
    input_ids = torch.stack([item[1] for item in batch])
    attn_mask = torch.stack([item[2] for item in batch])
    labels = torch.stack([item[3] for item in batch])
    logicvec = torch.stack([item[4] for item in batch])
    return imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec


class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class ClaimVerifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)


def logical_consistency_accuracy(preds, gts, logicvecs, claim_labels=None):
    correct = np.round(preds) == gts
    return np.mean(correct)


def train_on_dataset_singleclaim(name, dataset_train, dataset_val, in_c, ablation_key):
    print(f"\nTraining on {name} (claim diversity ablation)...")
    train_len = len(dataset_train)
    val_len = len(dataset_val)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        dataset_train,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        dataset_val,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate_fn,
        num_workers=2,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    model = ClaimVerifier(in_c, do_finetune_text=True).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LR)
    criterion = nn.BCELoss()

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        total_loss, correct = 0.0, 0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in train_loader:
            imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels = (
                imgs.to(device).float(),
                input_ids.to(device),
                attn_mask.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
            loss = criterion(output, labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
            preds = (output > 0.5).float()
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
            all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        train_acc = correct / train_len
        train_loss = total_loss / train_len
        tpreds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
        tgts = np.concatenate(all_gts)
        tlogicvecs = np.concatenate(all_logicvecs)
        train_logic = logical_consistency_accuracy(tpreds, tgts, tlogicvecs)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["metrics"]["train"].append(train_acc)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["losses"]["train"].append(train_loss)
        experiment_data[ablation_key][name]["metrics"]["train_logic"].append(
            train_logic
        )
        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss, vcorrect = 0.0, 0
        all_preds, all_gts, all_logicvecs = [], [], []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels, logicvec in val_loader:
                imgs, input_ids, attn_mask, labels = (
                    imgs.to(device).float(),
                    input_ids.to(device),
                    attn_mask.to(device),
                    labels.to(device),
                )
                output = model(imgs, input_ids, attn_mask)
                loss = criterion(output, labels)
                val_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)
                preds = (output > 0.5).float()
                vcorrect += (preds == labels).sum().item()
                all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_gts.append(labels.detach().cpu().numpy())
                all_logicvecs.append(logicvec.cpu().numpy())
        val_acc = vcorrect / val_len

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):

        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0

        res[

        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)

def collate_fn(batch):
    imgs = torch.stack([item[0] for item in batch])  # (B,3,28,28)

class CNNVisionEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_channels=9):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128 * 7 * 7, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)

class ClaimVerifier_NoAttnMask(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_c, do_finetune_text=True):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision = CNNVisionEncoder(input_channels=in_c)
        self.text = BertModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        for param in self.text.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = do_finetune_text
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 768, 192),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(192, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, imgs, input_ids, attn_mask):
        vis_feat = self.vision(imgs)
        txt_feat = self.text(input_ids=input_ids).last_hidden_state[
            :, 0, :
        ]  # No attention_mask
        x = torch.cat([vis_feat, txt_feat], dim=1)
        return self.fc(x).squeeze(1)

def pad_image(img, target_size=(28, 28)):
    if isinstance(img, np.ndarray):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = np.zeros((C, th, tw), dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    elif isinstance(img, torch.Tensor):
        C = img.shape[0]
        h, w = img.shape[1:3]
        th, tw = target_size
        if (h, w) == (th, tw):
            return img
        res = torch.zeros(C, th, tw, dtype=img.dtype)
        h_copy = min(h, th)
        w_copy = min(w, tw)
        h_start_res = (th - h) // 2 if h < th else 0
        w_start_res = (tw - w) // 2 if w < tw else 0
        h_start_img = (h - th) // 2 if h > th else 0
        w_start_img = (w - tw) // 2 if w > tw else 0
        res[
            :, h_start_res : h_start_res + h_copy, w_start_res : w_start_res + w_copy
        ] = img[
            :, h_start_img : h_start_img + h_copy, w_start_img : w_start_img + w_copy
        ]
        return res
    else:
        raise TypeError("Unknown type for pad_image")


def generate_claim(labels, available_claims):
    ctype = random.choice(available_claims)
    L = labels
    if ctype == "sum_even":
        label = int((sum(L) % 2) == 0)
        text = "The sum of the digits is even."
        subparts = [l for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_lt_5":
        label = int(all(l < 5 for l in L))
        text = "All digits are less than 5."
        subparts = [l < 5 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "exactly_two_odd":
        label = int(sum([l % 2 == 1 for l in L]) == 2)
        text = "Exactly two digits are odd numbers."
        subparts = [l % 2 == 1 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "at_least_one_is_7":
        label = int(any(l == 7 for l in L))
        text = "At least one digit is seven."
        subparts = [l == 7 for l in L]
    elif ctype == "all_unique":
        label = int(len(set(L)) == len(L))
        text = "All three digits are unique."
        uniqarr = [L.count(l) == 1 for l in L]
        subparts = uniqarr
    else:
        raise ValueError()
    return text, label, np.array(subparts, dtype=np.int64)


def get_available_claims(dsname):
    return [

        "all_lt_5",
        "exactly_two_odd",
        "at_least_one_is_7",

    ]

    def __init__(self, hfdata, num_samples=4000, dsname="mnist"):
        self.data = hfdata
        self.num_samples = num_samples
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.dsname = dsname
        self.available_claims = get_available_claims(dsname)
        self.samples = self._generate()

        N = len(self.data)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(self.num_samples):

            imgs = []
            labels = []
            for i in indices:

                imgs.append(torch.from_numpy(arr3))

            )
